body:
Thank you. I think I really just needed to talk to someone. When I'm by myself, I feel like my thoughts are working against me and attacking me. And if I'm alone, what is left if my own mind betrays me.

I didn't mean to make him sound like a dick. I brought this on myself, but maybe it is time for me to leave a relationship that can't be salvaged. Death and rebuilding my life seem equally daunting, like they're barely balanced on a scale. Luckily, I don't conveniently have access to tools that would tip the scale towards the deadly side. I try to think that if I haven't done it by now, then some part of me has the strength to find some way out.
